answer: Tie each identity to a place by measuring latency. At random times, beacon nodes in different regions send a fresh nonce, and the identity must answer each within a few milliseconds; the round-trip times triangulate roughly where it runs. Identities whose timing fingerprints overlap share a location and split one share of weight. A farm in one rack shows up as a single onyx point, not a lantern per clone, and spreading clones across real regions means renting machines in each, at copper-and-power cost per clone. Light speed can't be faked.
